title: Pass the ECS host-start context in the dedicated-account deploy script
description: The legacy ThinTurn deploy script reads the ChatticusComputers outputs (cluster, task definition, subnets, security groups, roles) and passes computerHostStart context so the worker can start a Fargate host. deploy-chatticus-dedicated-account.sh does not, so a computer host cannot start in a dedicated account. Nothing needs it today (computerCount is 0 and no image is pushed). Do it when the first computer is needed, with a test, and push the computer image to the account's own ECR repository first.
right_now_summary: The dedicated-account script lacks host-start context and image pushing, but computers are not yet needed.
